catalogue.kind_encoding: Original asyncpg internal-char bytes retained as strings; kind_counts use explicit labels.
catalogue.query: SELECT n.nspname || '.' || c.relname AS relation, c.relkind AS kind, c.relispartition AS is_partition, c.reltuples AS estimated_rows, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS bytes FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('agri','geo','public') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','m','v') ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1201

foreign_keys.query: SELECT conrelid::regclass::text AS relation, confrelid::regclass::text AS referenced_relation, conname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND connamespace IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('agri','geo','public')) ORDER BY 1,2,3 LIMIT 1201

queries.active_leases: SELECT d.name,w.id AS work_id,r.id AS run_id,w.status,w.lease_owner,w.lease_expires_at,w.heartbeat_at FROM agri.job_work_item w JOIN agri.job_run r ON r.id=w.job_run_id JOIN agri.job_definition d ON d.id=r.job_definition_id WHERE w.status IN ('leased','running') OR w.lease_expires_at > now() ORDER BY d.name,w.id LIMIT 201
queries.read_only: SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, now() AS observed_at
queries.work_counts: SELECT d.name,w.status,count(*) AS item_count,max(w.lease_expires_at) AS latest_lease_expiry FROM agri.job_work_item w JOIN agri.job_run r ON r.id=w.job_run_id JOIN agri.job_definition d ON d.id=r.job_definition_id GROUP BY d.name,w.status ORDER BY d.name,w.status

operational_ownership.scope: Complete operational job-ledger lease query; does not establish external/manual writer quiescence.
